disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by a tool error in the qwen model's full PKGBUILD review (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), not by divergent security analysis. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to complete full PKGBUILD review due to LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError)
learnings: Tool errors (API failures, timeouts) should be clearly distinguished from security findings in the verdict logic - a failed review is not evidence of risk
When one model experiences a tool error on a critical file like PKGBUILD, the system should either retry or escalate to another model rather than marking the entire package as inconclusive
Initial gate audits that succeed should be preserved and weighted when subsequent full reviews fail due to tool errors
